rows.text: Visibility must allow you to judge the space needed and complete the overtake without danger or obstruction.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — comma 2, lettere a e d: visibilità e spazio libero per completare il sorpasso

rows.text: A sign prohibiting overtaking must be obeyed even if the road looks clear.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 146, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-146.php — comma 1: obbligo di rispettare la segnaletica

rows.text: The quiz marks this VERO, but does not specify where the other driver is. The statement appears to refer to checking the driver behind: before overtaking, check that they have not already begun overtaking on the same carriageway or half-carriageway, or in the lane immediately to your left where lanes are marked. Also check that the driver ahead in the same lane has not signaled the same maneuver.
evidence: Fonte ufficiale AM, quesito 5181, domanda 26563, pagina PDF 124 (indice pagina 123), SHA-256 61d1e0516b972526401615d9cde18e8b2e60de754a70a97dca9edfb2c4347b30 — testo privo di posizione del conducente e risposta stampata VERO.

Codice della strada, art. 148, comma 2, lettere b e c, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — controllo del segnale del conducente che precede nella stessa corsia e del sorpasso già iniziato da chi segue nelle posizioni specificate; il riferimento del quiz a quest’ultimo controllo è un’interpretazione, non una limitazione espressa nel testo.

rows.text: The fact that an oncoming vehicle has ten meters in which to stop does not by itself show that overtaking is safe: there must be enough clear road to complete it, considering the difference in speeds and oncoming traffic.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, comma 2 lettera d, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-148/ — spazio per completare il sorpasso, differenza di velocità e utenti in senso contrario.

rows.text: The vehicle ahead slowing down does not itself prohibit overtaking; check that visibility and space are sufficient and the maneuver is safe.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — comma 2, lettere a e d: visibilità, sicurezza e spazio per il sorpasso

rows.text: An all-clear from the driver ahead is not required: the overtaking driver must personally check that the maneuver can be made without danger or obstruction.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — comma 2: verifiche preventive a carico di chi sorpassa

rows.text: The driver being overtaken must facilitate the maneuver without accelerating; on a road with one lane each way, they must keep as far right as possible.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — comma 4: agevolare, non accelerare e posizione a destra

rows.text: The driver being overtaken must also avoid creating danger or obstruction, facilitate the overtake and not accelerate.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 140, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-140.php — comma 1: evitare pericolo o intralcio; art. 148 comma 4: agevolare e non accelerare
Codice della strada, art. 148 comma 4, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — chi è sorpassato deve agevolare la manovra e non accelerare

rows.text: Drivers must not race: the driver being overtaken must facilitate the maneuver and not accelerate.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 141, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php — comma 5: divieto di gareggiare; art. 148 comma 4: agevolare e non accelerare
Codice della strada, art. 148 comma 4, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — chi è sorpassato deve agevolare la manovra e non accelerare

rows.text: Not accelerating helps the overtaking driver complete the maneuver; the driver being overtaken is required not to accelerate.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — comma 4: chi è sorpassato non deve accelerare

rows.text: The driver must not accelerate, but need not always slow down. In certain conditions a slow or bulky vehicle must slow down to let others pass.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — commi 4 e 5: non accelerare; obbligo di rallentare per determinati veicoli e condizioni

rows.text: Being overtaken does not require the right turn signal: facilitate the overtake and do not accelerate. The signal indicates a maneuver, not simply that someone is overtaking.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-154.php — commi 1, 2 e 4: segnalazione delle manovre e divieto di uso improprio; art. 148 comma 4: agevolare e non accelerare
Codice della strada, art. 148 comma 4, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — chi è sorpassato deve agevolare la manovra e non accelerare

rows.text: Do not move to the center to prevent other overtakes: facilitate the maneuver and, with one lane each way, keep as far right as possible.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — comma 4: agevolare e tenersi a destra sulle strade con una corsia per senso

rows.text: Accelerating to create a slipstream hinders overtaking: the driver being overtaken must facilitate it and not accelerate.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php — comma 4: agevolare e non accelerare

rows.text: To turn right, keep as close as possible to the right edge: this keeps your path near the edge instead of cutting unnecessarily across the roadway toward the right.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, commi 1 e 3 lettera a, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-154/ — manovra senza pericolo o intralcio e posizione vicino al margine destro; la traiettoria vicina al bordo è una conseguenza geometrica della posizione.

rows.text: Signal the turn sufficiently in advance with the direction indicator so others know your intention.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-154.php — commi 1 lettera b e 2: segnalazione anticipata e indicatori

rows.text: As you approach the intersection, adjust speed to the conditions to maintain control during the turn.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 141, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php — commi 1-3: velocità adeguata e controllo, anche presso intersezioni

rows.text: To turn right, keep as close as possible to the right edge, not the left: this limits the space you occupy on the roadway and leaves room for traffic.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, comma 3, lettera a, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-154/ — posizione vicino al margine destro per svoltare

rows.text: To turn right, do not move into the left lane: keep as close as possible to the right edge, limiting the space you occupy on the roadway and leaving room for traffic.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, comma 3, lettera a, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-154/ — posizione vicino al margine destro per svoltare
Tribunale di Pisa, sentenza 26 giugno 2025, n. 623, https://www.doctrine.it/decisions/ittrib93x18y6rm1fm3s — la posizione limita l’intralcio al traffico, anche nel senso opposto

rows.text: To turn right, do not move to the center of the intersection: keep as close as possible to the right edge, limiting the space you occupy on the roadway and leaving room for traffic.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, comma 3, lettera a, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-154/ — posizione vicino al margine destro per svoltare
Tribunale di Pisa, sentenza 26 giugno 2025, n. 623, https://www.doctrine.it/decisions/ittrib93x18y6rm1fm3s — la posizione limita l’intralcio al traffico, anche nel senso opposto

rows.text: On a two-way roadway, approach the center line as closely as possible to turn left. This prepares you for the turn while leaving space on your right for following vehicles where the road is wide enough.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, comma 3 lettera b, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-154/ — posizione vicino all’asse per la svolta a sinistra; lo spazio a destra dipende dalla larghezza disponibile.
Codice della strada, art. 148, comma 7, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-148/ — sorpasso a destra consentito se il veicolo davanti ha segnalato e iniziato la svolta a sinistra.

rows.text: Normally, turn near the center of the intersection, leaving it on your right, unless signs indicate otherwise. This path leaves room for an oncoming vehicle also turning left; you must still respect right-of-way rules.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, comma 3, lettera b, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-154/ — traiettoria presso e a sinistra del centro, salvo diversa segnalazione

Portale dell’Automobilista, quiz revisione superiori 2025, quesito 4428, domanda 22850 e relativa figura, https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BRevisione%2BSuperiore%2BItaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/43dea719-a62a-4d69-97fd-131c64276490 — due veicoli opposti svoltano lasciando il centro alla propria destra; lo spazio reciproco è una deduzione geometrica
Codice della strada, art. 145, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-145.php — obblighi di precedenza alle intersezioni

rows.text: When paths cross, yield to traffic from the right unless signs indicate otherwise; turning left does not remove this obligation.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 145, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-145.php — comma 2: precedenza a destra salvo diversa segnalazione

rows.text: On a two-way roadway approach the center line, not the left edge, which is the reference for a one-way roadway.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 154, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-154.php — comma 3 lettera b: asse sul doppio senso e margine sinistro sul senso unico

rows.text: Speed does not replace yielding: use caution, respect the applicable right of way and turn without danger or obstruction.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 145, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-145.php — commi 1 e 2: prudenza e precedenza; art. 154 comma 1 lettera a: manovra senza pericolo o intralcio

issues: 26564: The wording says leaving ten metres for an oncoming vehicle is not enough, which can be read as an absolute minimum-distance judgment. Article 148(2)(d) instead requires sufficient clear space for the complete manoeuvre, considering speeds and oncoming traffic; ten metres of stopping space is not the legal test. Clarify that this proposed test alone does not establish safety in all four languages.

26575: The explanation repeats the required position and says it positions the driver correctly, but gives no substantive reason for the right-edge position. Add a supported explanation of its function instead of a circular restatement, consistently in all four languages.

26581: The text restates the required approach to the centre and adds the separate rule about not entering the other road against traffic, but does not explain why the driver approaches the centre for a left turn. Supply the decisive reason in all four languages with supporting evidence.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1e9f5-ffc5-73d0-9c39-9cdc3f943c60
issues: 26563: The printed VERO assertion says no driver has already begun the same manoeuvre without limiting where that driver is. Article 148(2)(b)-(c) instead specifies a prior signal from the vehicle ahead in the same lane and a manoeuvre begun by a following driver in specified positions. The explanation silently substitutes these narrower checks without acknowledging the wording ambiguity or explaining how the printed verdict is to be reconciled with it. Adjudicate the source wording and add a supported, explicitly qualified explanation in all four languages while preserving VERO.
